# v0.4.0 — Per-messenger media gallery: see what you're cleaning

## Browse the media of each messenger

Clicking a messenger row (Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Signal, Slack,
Element) now opens a **media gallery** instead of jumping to the results
table:

- **Real thumbnails**: photos through Tauri's asset protocol, videos with
  a first-frame preview, icons for audio and documents
- **Filter by type** (images, videos, audio, documents) and pagination for
  folders with thousands of files
- **Select one item or all of them** with checkboxes — tiles toggle on
  click too — and a selection bar shows the count and size
- **Clean goes to the trash** after confirmation; media is user data and
  stays recoverable

## Content sniffing finds media without extensions

Modern messengers store photos and videos as hash-named blobs with no
extension. The new sniffer classifies files by their magic bytes — JPEG,
PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, HEIC, MP4, M4A, MOV, MKV/WebM, OGG, MP3, FLAC, WAV,
AVI and PDF — so Discord's cached images and WhatsApp's media show up in
the gallery with real previews. On a real-world profile the gallery finds
147 viewable media files in Discord and 21 in WhatsApp.

One honest limit: **Telegram's new cache is encrypted** (TDEF container)
and cannot be previewed. The gallery says so and points to the
page-level clean, which handles the whole cache directory regardless.
